Demonstration board — not live. This page is a static illustration of an operating scoreboard. It is not connected to any accounting, estimating or scheduling system, and nothing on it updates. Monthly and weekly installed-revenue totals, job counts and the accounts-receivable aging are drawn from the client’s own historical records; job-level cost detail, the overhead and profit plan, the forward schedule and the sold-estimate pipeline are representative sample values supplied so that every panel renders in full. Customer names are substitutes. Nothing here should be relied on as a financial statement.
